modules.module_title: Recognizing the welding requirements, welding equipment and parameters

pcs.pc_description: recognize the right welding methodology and process to be adopted for completing the work order
refer all process manuals/ work instructions/Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) to understand the right welding methodology and process
discuss with the supervisor for given task/work

identify the various welding parameters like temperature, pressure, electrode type, electrode distance, process cycle time etc. before starting the welding process, as mentioned in the work Instructions/ SOP manual
identify the material required and the equipment availability for executing the activity

compare various type of electrode in terms of electrode material and thickness, filler material and flux which will be required for the selected welding process before the initiation of the welding process

modules.module_title: Arrange the material and equipment

pcs.pc_description: arrange the correct type of electrodes as per material wise, dimension wise, filler material wise etc. used for the welding process
arrange the material and the equipment required for executing the activity
procure all required material from the store before starting the welding process

modules.module_title: Clean the welding equipment and setup the equipment

pcs.pc_description: clean the surface of the electrodes and remove dust and any other impurities from the welding gun

clean the other welding machine auxiliaries(welding transformer, gas discharge unit, flux wire) before the initiation of the welding process, as mentioned in the work instructions/ Standard Operating Procedures(SOP)
setup the welding apparatus as per the selected welding process and the internal SOPs/ Work instructions and the setting standard for the machine

modules.module_title: Prepare the surface of the part ( work pieces)

pcs.pc_description: clean the surface of the metal parts (work pieces) which need to be joint
prepare the edge for the strongest possible weld using techniques like machining, chipping, grinding, oxy- acetylene cutting and carbon arc cutting
ensure that the parameters for edge parameters are as per the desired specifications like speed, cost, adaptability etc.
take the work permission/authorization from mines manager if required

modules.module_title: Install the welding work pieces on the welding apparatus

pcs.pc_description: hold the parts (Jigs) which need to be welded together using a clamp and align them with the electrodes as per the job requirement

install the work pieces on the welding apparatus keeping in mind the electrodes distance, contact area, pressure, temperature application etc as specified in the welding SOP/ Control plan documents/work Instructions and instructed by the supervisor

modules.module_title: Check the operations of the welding machines and auxiliaries and conduct a test process

pcs.pc_description: check for operation of core welding equipment like welding gun, welding transformer, gas cylinders and gas discharge as per setup documentation
identify shift direction hazard
conduct destructive and non- destructive test activity to ensure conformance to the SOPs/ work instructions
inform supervisor to make modifications in the welding parameters as per the test activity outcomes and the prescribed standard for destructive/ non destructive Tests

modules.module_title: Perform the actual welding process

pcs.pc_description: adjust the current/ voltage, temperature application as per the welding requirement and the activity test conducted earlier so that the desired heat can be created for the welding process
check for the positioning of the spot and the welding gun as per the work instructions and the work order

/ hold the filler metal/ Flux material wire and the Welding Gun at the recommended angle and distance mentioned in the setup document, keeping the work pieces stationary to ensure the required melting of base metal
ensure the flow of filler material/ gas discharge as per the welding standard prescribed in the SOP/ Work Instructions

modules.module_title: Monitor process parameters to ensure error free welding process

pcs.pc_description: monitor the welding process ( Pressure, Temperature, gas discharge flow, electrode force, electrode distance etc) by observing the readings on the panels/ measuring instruments to prevent any harm to the work pieces due to overheating, burning, over melting, change in applied pressure etc
note down the observations in the prescribed format

modules.module_title: Measure both welded pieces and remove welding inconsistency

pcs.pc_description: measure the final welded piece and compare the dimensions as prescribed in the work order engineering drawing
ensure that the assistant operators/ helpers remove extra material by using chippers, grinders etc., in case the parts are not as per the given measurements
ensure hammering of the bulges to give the work pieces the desired shape, in case of any dents or bulges

modules.module_title: Inspection of finished goods to detect any deviations from the product design

pcs.pc_description: inspect the output products by comparing the dimensions of the output pieces with the specifications of the finished product using various measuring devices like micrometers, vernier calipers, gauges, rulers, weighing scales and etc.
compare texture, color, surface properties, hardness and strength with the given specifications described the in work order/ work Instructions
separate the defective pieces into two categories e.i. repairable and beyond repair by putting tags/ markings on the welded jig/ workpiece surface
ensure that the pieces which are not meet the specified standard and cannot be repaired are discarded

modules.module_title: Maintain records for production and defective pieces

pcs.pc_description: maintain data records for quality defects and pieces which are beyond repair
prepare all documentation correctly on time
report completion of job allocated during the shift, problems encountered and further actions that need to be taken

modules.module_title: Unload and store the finished goods

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the output pieces is correctly clamped and lifted using suitable equipment like hoist, lifts, crane, etc.
ensure that there is no damage to the lifted work pieces
carry the output product to the designated area using hangars, conveyor belts, cranes, forklifts etc.

modules.module_title: Ensure cleanliness and 5S is maintained at the workplace

pcs.pc_description: store all equipment in a proper order as indicated in the equipment manual and the designated area
ensure that the equipment and the work place are regularly cleaned and that there is not accumulation of dust, moisture and waste material
follow "5-S" practice at work place

modules.module_title: Conduct regular preventive maintenance of equipment

pcs.pc_description: check the working of all bearing, rollers, shafts etc. and oil all moving parts of the equipment on a periodic basis
check the working of non-moving parts and periodically conduct preventive maintenance to prevent machine failure
check the equipment calibration periodically and report any errors to the maintenance teams for rectification

modules.module_title: Follow work-site health and safety measures

pcs.pc_description: undertake "The Take-5 (Personal Risk Assessment)" before commencement of any work
comply with safety, health and security- related regulations/guidelines at the mine e.g. follow Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for material handling in underground (U/G) mine
operate various types of fire extinguishers to control different types of fire at a worksite when required

follow precautions against U/G electrical appliances

follow the manufacturer’s instructions for care and safe operation of mine machinery and equipment
identify the working ventilation district from line diagram of ventilation circuit to direct air to the working face
follow Safety Management Plan (SMP) and Emergency Management Plan (EMP)
follow gas detecting alarm signal on leakage of inflammable gases and laid out procedure to ensure safety
follow process for reporting any unsafe act/condition in work area to the concerned person
use underground mine communication system
ensure positive isolation near the work place if applicable
use appropriate PPE as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify six directional hazards at workplace and take decisions accordingly

modules.module_title: Follow environmental guidelines

pcs.pc_description: identify the environmental impact of mining related operations and follow steps to reduce those impact
follow the mineral conservation practices in U/G mining operations to achieve optimum ore or mineral recovery
ensure that the stowing practices produce minimum disturbance to the surface
ensure that the subgrade ore is carried out to surface and stacked separately at the earmarked place
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
follow the "5-S" practice at work site like cleaning oil from ground (to avoid soil from getting damaged), etc.
